title: update_last_message_at propagates error after atomic insert succeeds
description: crates/kith-chat/src/message.rs:409-414: after insert_outbound_message commits (message + outbox rows in DB, delivery guaranteed), update_last_message_at failure causes process_create to return Err(...) → caller sees notCreated but message is already stored and will be delivered to peers. Caller retry generates a true duplicate (new ULID, no idempotency key from the owner side). Comment says 'best-effort cache' but .map_err(...)? propagates the error. Fix: change to let _ = guard.chats().update_last_message_at(...); — swallow the error since the comment already documents this intent.
